pack.description: The forward effects as 0.44a5 draws them, with client patch 169: a DXT1 transparency map (CONFIG_USE_OLTA) and the distortion of the emissive map alone (CONFIG_USE_FUZZINESS) in the masks of forward_base and offscreen_particle_lighting, players' programs under their wider keys, and 0.44a5's (= 0.32a4's) forward, particle lighting and z-shifted vertex programs players lack
